meta.title: Eating Street Food for 50 Hours in Hanoi, Vietnam | (Street Food, Egg Coffee, Michelin Eats & More)
meta.description:
My 50-Hour Ultimate Food Guide to Hanoi, Vietnam! 🇻🇳

In this episode, I ate my way through every flavour that defines Hanoi’s street food magic — from iconic Egg Coffee and legendary Pho, to Michelin-star meals, train street food, Indian food, night market snacks, and sweet & savoury breakfasts that locals swear by.

If you’re planning your Vietnam travel, this guide will show you exactly where to eat, what to try, and how to experience Hanoi like a true foodie.

🍜 What’s Inside:
Legendary Hanoi Pho 🍲
Iconic Egg Coffee ☕️
Michelin-Star Local Eatery ⭐️
Train Street Food 🚂
Night Market Vibes 🌙
Hidden Indian Gem 🇮🇳
Street Desserts & Local Drinks 🍧

📍 Perfect for: Foodies, travellers, and anyone dreaming of Vietnam’s vibrant food culture.

Tell me your favourite dish in the comments and don’t forget to join the #FoodFam for more delicious adventures!

✨ Subscribe for more cinematic food journeys → @SinfulFoodie
